title: Commercial Business Assistant
description:
Commercial Business Assistant
Location: Stamford, Lincolnshire - Office based ( No hybrid option )
Hours - Monday - Friday - Full time

Salary : Competitive, based on experience and suitability for the role

Our client is recruiting for a highly professional, commercially minded and exceptionally organised Commercial Business Assistant to provide high-level support to the CEO while playing an important role in the company's commercial activities.
This is a varied position combining executive-level administration, business coordination and creative sales proposal development. The successful candidate will be comfortable operating at senior level, managing competing priorities and producing polished, persuasive sales proposals that reflect the company's professional standards.

We are looking for someone who combines outstanding organisational ability with commercial awareness, creative thinking and strong technical skills.

The Commercial Business Assistant Role
Working closely with the CEO, you will provide comprehensive executive and administrative support, helping to ensure the smooth and efficient running of the business.

Alongside your executive responsibilities, you will support the commercial function by developing creative, tailored sales proposals and presentations that respond to client requirements and help generate new business.
This role requires someone who can move confidently between high-level administrative responsibilities and commercially focused projects. You will need to demonstrate initiative, discretion and sound judgement, alongside the ability to produce excellent work to tight deadlines.

Key Commercial Business Assistant Responsibilities
Executive Support to the CEO
- Provide high-level administrative and organisational support to the CEO, ensuring day-to-day priorities are managed effectively.
- Manage diary commitments, coordinate meetings and organise appointments, ensuring time is prioritised efficiently.
- Prepare correspondence, reports, presentations and other executive documentation to a consistently high standard.
- Coordinate meetings, prepare relevant information and ensure actions and follow-ups are completed.
- Handle confidential and sensitive information with discretion and professionalism.
- Manage incoming communications, helping to prioritise requests and ensure important matters receive appropriate attention.
- Coordinate business travel, appointments and other arrangements as required.
- Proactively anticipate the CEO's needs, identify priorities and take ownership of tasks to support the effective running of the business.
- Act as a professional point of contact for internal and external stakeholders, representing the business to a high standard.
Sales Proposals & Commercial Support
- Create and develop high-quality, creative and tailored sales proposals that respond to individual client requirements.
- Produce professional presentations and supporting documents that clearly communicate the company's offering and commercial value.
- Interpret client briefs and develop compelling proposals that help convert enquiries into business opportunities.
- Work closely with the team to support sales activity and ensure proposals are delivered accurately and within agreed deadlines.
- Use creative thinking to develop engaging ways of presenting information and differentiating the company's offering.
- Support the preparation of quotations, commercial documentation and client-facing materials as required.
- Maintain a professional and consistent standard across all sales proposals and communications.
Business Coordination & Administration
- Coordinate multiple projects and priorities, ensuring deadlines and commitments are met.
- Maintain organised records, documentation and business information.
- Support the preparation of reports, business documents and management information as required.
- Identify opportunities to improve administrative processes and make more effective use of technology.
- Liaise with colleagues, clients and external contacts to ensure effective communication and coordination.
- Provide additional administrative and operational support to the business as required.

title: Part Time Administrator
description:
Part-Time Sales & Reception Administrator

We re looking for a friendly, organised Sales & Reception Administrator to join a busy team on a part-time basis until the end of December.

This is a varied role, combining reception, customer service, sales administration and general office support, so no two days are necessarily the same.

What you ll be doing as a Administrator:
- Meeting and greeting visitors and guests
- Making drinks for visitors and accepting deliveries
- Processing membership sales and updating the database
- Adding searches and photographs to members brochure pages on the website
- Providing holiday cover and general support to the team
- Calling members to check they have their ID and password details
- Franking and preparing outgoing post
- Preparing badges for external events
- Answering calls within the department
- Making external calls to obtain receipts or carrying out pre-arrival calls when required to support the reservations team
- Assisting with hotel invoice processing and credit control when required

About you as a Administrator:

We re looking for someone who is friendly, reliable and organised, with a good telephone manner and the ability to deal confidently with customers and visitors.

You ll need to be comfortable working as part of a team, but also happy to use your own initiative and get on with things independently.

Good English, maths and ICT skills are important, along with a basic working knowledge of Microsoft Word and Excel.

Hours & Salary

This is expected to be a part-time position, working approximately 10am 2pm, although the hours are negotiable for the right person.

There may also be opportunities for additional hours when required, particularly to provide holiday or event cover.

If you're looking for a friendly part-time role with plenty of variety, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Production Administrator
description:
BCP are part of Barrett Steel, the UK s largest steel distributor and processor, with over 160 years of heritage we are still family owned and operate from 29 sites across the UK and Ireland, holding more than 120,000 tonnes of steel stock. Although we are a business with significant scale, our success is built on the people who make it happen every day. We continually invest in our people, the latest processing machinery, technology, and materials-handling equipment so that we can deliver an exceptional service to our customers. Our people, our customers, and the communities in which we operate are at the heart of what we do. We are a forward-thinking business that values hard work, ambition, teamwork, and are always open to new ideas.

All about the role

To support the efficient operation of the production function by coordinating plans, processing orders, managing incoming loads and providing accurate administrative support across production, sales and logistics. The hours are Monday to Friday 8.30 am to 4.30 pm.

Key Responsibilities
- Prepare, maintain and update production plans and schedules in line with customer demand, available capacity and delivery requirements.
- Monitor production progress, identify potential delays and communicate priorities or changes to relevant teams.
- Liaise with Production, Sales, Transport and Warehouse colleagues to support the smooth flow of work.
- Process and manage intergroup sales orders, ensuring pricing, quantities, delivery dates and documentation are accurate.
- Release production orders within the relevant system in accordance with the agreed schedule and material availability.
- Check order information before release and resolve any missing or conflicting data with the appropriate department.
- Build and coordinate incoming loads, recording expected deliveries and ensuring load details are communicated to Warehouse and Production teams.
- Maintain accurate records for incoming materials, production orders, stock movements and delivery documentation.
- Carry out production programming, entering and maintaining job, machine or process instructions within company systems.
- Ensure programmes and production data reflect current specifications, priorities and required completion dates.
- Produce and distribute production paperwork, reports, schedules, labels and supporting documentation as required.
- Complete general administrative duties, including data entry, filing, document control, email correspondence and responding to internal queries.
- Maintain high standards of data accuracy and confidentiality across all systems and records.
- Support continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to simplify administrative processes and improve production efficiency.
- Comply with company procedures, health and safety requirements and quality standards at all times.
- Undertake other reasonable duties required to support the Production and Operations teams.

Skills and Attributes
- Strong organisational, planning and prioritisation skills.
- Excellent attention to detail and a high level of accuracy.
- Clear written and verbal communication skills.
- Confident working with multiple departments and managing changing priorities.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word and Outlook.
- Ability to learn production planning and programming systems.
- Proactive, dependable and able to work independently as well as part of a team.
- Calm and methodical when working to deadlines in a busy manufacturing environment.

We offer you
- Competitive salary depending on your experience
- 25 days holiday pro rata plus bank holidays
- Pension & Life Assurance
- Discounts on retail and leisure
- Access to health and well being services

Giving advise on partner services for patients to be able to contact such as pharmacy minor ailments and physio, Push Doctor etc. Be able to use the system one application to amend patient information, issue prescriptions, issue online access logins and update records appropriately. Updating patient demographics by collecting the information at each contact. Protect patient confidentiality. Add appropriate home visits along with information for clinical team. Be able to amend and add information such as BP and smoking statuses to QOF requirements. Entering accurate, relevant, concise data/details into the patient record and transferring messages to the appropriate person through nominated pathways i.e., task. Completing returned task requests, and relaying accurate information to nominated people. Re-visiting computerised records to ensure accuracy of information entered. Use accurx to full potential by sending/ requesting information and dealing with responses succinctly. Know how to find pathology and radiology results, respond appropriately to patient or Clinical staff with results. Know how to utilise systems (following training) for patients on INR and advise, record and complete appropriately. Using NHS Email communication system and ensuring this is checked regularly as this is an inhouse communication method. Recording outgoing documents and processing small amounts of cash handling, recording these appropriately. Assisting with incoming processing of prescriptions via all medium of receipt (post, electronic, telephone etc) to include booking of monitoring bloods when required, passing to the appropriate team for amending/adding of medication and assisting with the monthly recalls for vulnerable patient prescriptions. Assisting with the printing of repeat prescriptions, ensuring security and compliance to practice policy for collection and safety of prescriptions. All these processes will be overviewed by the GPs for assurance and safety. Updating patient records with nominated pharmacy, including out of area holiday requests. Liaising with the District Nurses and other clinicians to ensure housebound patients are reviewed. Sending appropriate electronic referrals. Upholding the practice policies and guidance on Confidentiality, Health and Safety, Infection control and equality and diversity. Completion of mandatory training in a timely manner, ensuring updated at appropriate time periods and attendance on a minimum basis of two staff meetings per annum. (Where off duty this will be reimbursed). Receive incoming calls and messages presented via Emma AI assistant which will require you to respond, and allocate as needed to assist the patient. Answering the phone while maintaining a polite, consistent phone manner, on both the appointment line and the general enquiries line and directing calls appropriately. This is a high pressure, fast paced role that requires quick thinking and empathy whist adhering to protocols where a polite manner is needed to reassure the caller, they are being cared for to the best of the practices ability. will cover completion of reception task inbox, daily DNA s, seasonal campaigns, Qof recalls, patient reminders for appointments, surveys. Registering patients and collating the appropriate documents for this purpose. Be able to use remote booking system for services run by the practice at alternative locations. Record a pregnancy or death and inform appropriate team. Have an all-round understanding of QOF and the required appointments. Any other duties as may be delegated. The Operations Manager reserves the right to alter or amend this job description in consultation with the post holder.

title: Patient Administrator

description: Do you have excellent communication and administration skills with recent experience of working in a busy office environment where no two days are the same? Are you a proficient Microsoft Office and IT user? If you're looking for a rewarding administrative role where you can make a positive difference to people's experience of the NHS, then joining our patient admin services team and working alongside our community nursing and specialist services colleagues could be right for you. We're looking for experienced administrators who can transfer their skills to the NHS, ensuring that our community clinicians and patients are always supported with expert admin help. You should be willing and available to work on a rota basis usually between 0800-17:00hrs Monday to Friday. Roles in Lincoln/Skegness & Mablethorpe - other bases to be confirmed but can potentially work from any of our offices countywide Following policies, procedures and quality standards, to provide a professional and efficient administrative service which enables our clinical teams to focus on delivering patient care. To be the first person our patients see when they arrive at the health clinic and ensure a welcoming environment. To communicate in a timely, sensitive and empathetic manner with patients and clients either verbally or non-verbally, ensuring accurate details are recorded and either actioned or passed in a timely manner to the responsible person/team. To support our clinical teams to ensure they have enough stock, paperwork and equipment to complete their day to day tasks. Provide a range of administrative functions, which may include producing letters, processing patient referrals, scanning, photocopying, taking minutes, booking rooms, sorting post and other office/administration duties. Welcome our patient as they arrive at the reception desks of the health clinic and ensure their arrival is logged on our patient information system Monitor voicemails and respond to enquiries from patients and clients, including handling potentially difficult calls, in a professional manner, assessing the urgency, taking messages and passing to the relevant person where necessary. Book, amend or cancel patient appointments, by telephone or face to face, ensuring all records are updated and patients and clients are informed. Advise patients on access to and use of services. Maintain accurate patient records using both computer and paper. Receive, record, transmit, store and retrieve information from paper or electronic records and databases. Open and close the clinic Assist in the monitoring, control and ordering of stock and supplies in accordance with LCHS procedures. Unlock premises/ensure premises are securely locked and alarms are set prior to leaving the premises, if required. Adhere to LCHS's information governance requirements, treat all information as confidential and abide by the Data Protection Act.
